risk_notes: Every provider result remains a third-party claim until source-specific human appraisal.
Campaigns are network-free dry runs unless --execute is explicitly supplied, and completed provider requests are skipped unless --refresh is explicitly supplied.

Official-host transport, contracts, persistence, and gates are offline-verified; Europe PMC, PubMed, ClinicalTrials.gov, and Crossref passed bounded live pilots, while other live providers retain explicit configuration or throttling caveats.
Unpaywall and Europe PMC resolve lawful open copies only; unavailable full text never silently satisfies full_text_verified.
Initial list processing is deterministic; fuzzy duplicate matches, ambiguous eligibility and every final screening decision retain explicit human boundaries.
LLM output is proposal-only, requires verbatim supplied spans and cannot transition the review ledger.
Search saturation rejects replayed snapshots and screening readiness fails closed when any required human or negative-control gate is absent.
Campaign replays skip completed acquisitions after transport interruption, but the current HTTP transport does not automatically retry an incomplete chunked response inside one process.
Passing every evidence gate grants A0 planning readiness only and never recommendation or execution authority.
Clinical candidates fail closed until clinician review is explicitly recorded.
